title: VR-Hands-Interactions-Adapted: experimental data and analysis scripts on hand interactions in adapted virtual environments
description: Experimental data and Python analysis scripts on hand interactions in adapted and non-adapted virtual reality environments, including difficulty indexing and visualisation of hand movement, from the VR-Shopping case study with users with motor disabilities. This work was supported by the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities / Agencia Estatal de Investigación under grant PID2020-117361RB-C21 (project REHAB-IMMERSIVE), and carried out by the AIR Research Group of the Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha in collaboration with the Hospital Nacional de Parapléjicos (Toledo, Spain).
